status: Specified before inspecting participant-level outcomes; source article findings already known. Not preregistered.
scope: Focused reanalysis of negative/positive affect and alcohol-use likelihood plus coping-motive moderation; not reproduction of every specification curve or permutation test.
primary: Compare within-person negative affect with alcohol-use likelihood, separating use probability from quantity. Use author-processed temporally filtered data if measurement audit confirms its meaning.
models: Unmoderated within-person negative affect predicting alcohol-use probability
Negative affect plus positive affect to assess specificity
Negative affect by baseline coping-motives interaction
sensitivity: Negative affect using daily mean versus last available prior-use report, if available
Use author imputations and compare complete observations when the original non-imputed data are supplied
requirements: Verify units and codebook against processing script
Record observations, participants and exclusions for every model
Report convergence and singularity problems; no selective model omission
Use pooled uncertainty across supplied multiple imputations
Distinguish emotion, appraisal and coping motives; no claim that appraisal was measured
No causal mediation or treatment-effect claims
potential_extension: Test whether within-person distress–drinking associations differ by coping motives, framed as a focused explanatory probe rather than a novel finding if already tested in the source article.
